node.title: Re: Selecting Password
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
system qq {echo -e "$newpassword\n$newpassword" | passwd $username}

I explained the issues with running external commands like this in my node [id://1180578|here]. In this case, [hippo] has a [id://11112169|good point] about using existing modules, but if you absolutely must run an external command, in this case I might suggest [mod://IPC::Run3], as it allows you to avoid the shell and feed the external command some STDIN.
